scope: Adversarial full-validator unit probes; not model or UI observations

production_evidence.title: What Medicare is
production_evidence.text: Medicare is health insurance from the federal government. It helps pay for health care. It is mainly for people 65 or older who meet the program’s eligibility rules. Some younger people qualify because of a disability, End-Stage Renal Disease, or ALS. You can learn the coverage pieces one at a time.
production_evidence.summary: Medicare is federal health insurance. We’ll build the rest of the picture one piece at a time.
production_evidence.question: What is Medicare?
